title: eriophorum vaginatum var. brachyantherum
intro: Eriophorum vaginatum var. brachyantherum, commonly known as short-spiked cotton-grass, is a plant species in the sedge family, characterized by its unique, cotton-like seeds and narrow leaves. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote respiratory health and alleviate symptoms associated with bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of short-spiked cotton-grass include anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and mucolytic properties, which can help to soothe and protect the mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
